title: EquiDermAI: An Inclusive Deep-Generative Framework to Overcome Racial & Regional Barriers in Skin Disease Diagnosis
summary: EquiDermAI combines generated skin-lesion images and compact models to target diagnostic disparities, with full validation still ongoing.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: IIT Madras describes skin-tone data augmentation and on-device dermatology models. Mobile prototyping and validation are ongoing. Fairer diagnostic performance, lower energy use, and access in resource-constrained settings are intended benefits. The cited health disparities describe the problem, not improvements already produced by this system.
purpose: Improve dermatology-model performance across skin tones and low-resource devices.

ratings.reason: EquiDermAI is at initial mobile-prototype validation; no patient is shown to have benefited.
Fairer skin-tone performance and lower mortality are intended effects; the cited disparities are background, not project outcomes.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 22: EquiDermAI: An Inclusive Deep-Generative Framework to Overcome Racial & Regional Barriers in Skin Disease Diagnosis

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: EquiDermAI targets skin-tone gaps in dermatology AI

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
